gate_type: CORRECTION gate (Issue #91 SA comment 5644974241): fix two contract-level inconsistencies inside the frozen VF-SHW-X1 contract layer. No runtime, no PID implementation, no UI, no PIM change, no X2 start.
sa_decision_ref: Issue #91 comment 5644974241 (Finding A: X2 process contract depends on a C2 loop; Finding B: T100 low/high interlock direction) - previous head ec57d7d
architecture_authority_ref: VF-SHW-X1 report/evidence (SHW_WHOLE_PLANT_CONTRACTS_FROZEN) + X0 freeze; contract layer only, the canonical architecture is unchanged
objective: Make the X2 admission self-sufficient at contract level: (1) no process input of an X2-admitted scope may require a C2 controller output - every controller-sourced X2 input must be produced by an X2-active C1 control or carry an explicit declared X2 fallback/default, while the deferred PI/PID loops stay C2 + inactive + later-gate and are annotated as such; (2) the T100 (and T108) level-action contracts must name the correct upstream/downstream actuator ownership and direction (low/low-low protects downstream withdrawal and keeps upstream refill permitted; high/high-high inhibits upstream intake and keeps downstream withdrawal permitted); (3) focused fail-closed validation plus evidence for both rules.
explicit_non_objectives: No runtime implementation and no whole-plant runtime start
No PI/PID dynamics, no controller evaluation, no X2 activation of any C2 loop
No PIM write or PIM semantic change
No new control added to the X2 active C1 set
No ASSY change and no change to other SH-WTP modules
forbidden_paths_note: tests/ is intentionally NOT listed as a whole-directory forbidden entry (the required corrections are covered by the existing X1 test module, so test changes must be confined to tests/test_vnext_x1_whole_plant_contracts.py through the allowlist); no other test module may change. The frozen whole-plant graph is NOT edited: the correction only changes process-input ownership/provenance, control-level actuator ownership/direction and the admission classification of the affected scope.
required_deliverables: configs/vnext/shwtp/shwtp_process_contracts_v1.json (X2 producer resolution for every controller-sourced input; explicit raw-intake X2 speed command; explicit DIST-P108 X2 fallback default)
configs/vnext/shwtp/shwtp_control_contracts_v1.json (X2 actuator commands on the owning C1 controls; corrected T100/T108 actuator ownership + level_action_policy; deferred C2 annotations)
src/virtual_factory/shwtp/contracts.py (fail-closed X2 input-resolution validator + level-action direction validator + read-only audit helpers)
required_smoke_checks: Canonical baseline green at the pushed head
Full suite green at the pushed head
forbidden_actions: Activating or evaluating any C2 loop in X2
Changing the frozen whole-plant graph or its signature
Runtime, session, bridge, engine or controller construction
stop_conditions: A correction would require changing the frozen whole-plant graph topology or adding a PIM semantic identity
The X2-safe behaviour cannot be declared without inventing a materially different product behaviour
A correction would require activating a C2 loop in X2
A required actuator owner does not exist in the frozen contracts

acceptance_criteria.description: Every process input of an X2-admitted scope resolves to an X2 producer (process node, scenario boundary, X2-active C1 control or explicit declared X2 fallback/default) and no admitted scope requires a C2 controller output

RAW-INTAKE has an explicit X2-safe C1 actuator behaviour (C1 duty/standby owns RUN/STOP + a deterministic declared synthetic/reference fixed or rule-based speed/flow command) and the C2 raw-flow-pi stays inactive and only modulates in X4

T100 low/low-low and high/high-high actions identify the correct actuator ownership/direction (low protects downstream withdrawal, upstream refill permitted; high inhibits upstream intake, downstream withdrawal permitted) and no site-truth claim is made

The same defect class is closed everywhere it occurs in the admitted set (T106, T108, DIST-P108), the deferred C2 loops stay deferred, V1-V12 evidence is green, the 44/44 baseline is green and the full suite is green
